description: Eval corpus for cami-design. Each case tests whether the skill catches a specific principle or anti-pattern. `references` lists the reference file(s) the case targets; the runner loads them into the system prompt so the eval tests skill content, not base-model knowledge. Run with: npm run eval

evals.description: Detects side-stripe border anti-pattern

evals.input: Review this loading message: "Herding pixels and making magic happen..."

evals.input: Review this error message: "Your file could not be uploaded due to an error."

evals.description: Does not recommend the banned vague 'Oops, something went wrong' error
evals.input: We need a friendly, human error message for when saving fails. Is "Oops, something went wrong" a good choice? Review it.

evals.description: Flags disabled attribute instead of aria-disabled
evals.input:
Review this submit button:

```tsx
<button
  disabled={!isFormValid}
  onClick={handleSubmit}
  className="btn-primary"
>
  Save changes
</button>
```
